title: articles-of-association
author: Marianne Niviaq Thomsen
details:
Please make the changes shown in the attached Word document.

Highlights:
• p.5 “a. The notice convening the general meeting
• b. The aggregate number of shares and voting rights as at the date of the notice
• c. The documents to be presented at the general meeting
• d. The agenda” → Please amend to remove the bullets, so the numbering only consist of the letters.
• p.7 “ear. As adopted at the extraordinary general
meeting on 13 May 2026 and latest amended by decision of the board of directors on 19 May” → This needs to be on a separat, independent line, without any numbering as in the original document.
• p.2 “Share capital and shares” → Can you make the headings bigger?
• p.2 “Name and objects
1.1 The Company’s name is BioMar Group A/S.
1.2 The object of the Company is to engage in development, research, production and trade activities
within feed and aquaculture as well as” → Please match the layout of the original document by indenting each article away from the left margin.

b. The aggregate number of shares and voting rights as at the date of the notice
c. The documents to be presented at the general meeting
d. The agenda and t” → Please move the list further away from the margin so it align with the text of the other articles.
